verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation-relevant acceptance rule that all narration after the opening must be delivered exactly according to the supplied script.
The client supplies the approved post-opening narration that the video must deliver; the existing delivery rule remains compatible, so no prior key requires removal.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that the delivered video followed the script, made in direct response to the client's contrary review.
The client cancels the offer and states that the video will not be used, terminating the task-local obligation to deliver the remaining script.
